airtac.readme:
# AIRTAC

A voice-driven personal AI assistant.

## What it does
- Summarises your GitHub activity and open issues
- Reads today's LeetCode problem and suggests practice
- Fetches Hacker News, arXiv papers and Codeforces contests
- Remembers facts you tell it and makes PDFs

## Run it
python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
pip install -r requirements.txt
uvicorn app.main:app --reload

## Modes
Mock (no keys), demo (public, sample data) and live (real APIs).
